statement: The Euclidean Steinitz–Bergström bound. Proves that any finite sequence in the Euclidean unit ball of ℝd admits signs keeping every partial sum within $`C\sqrt d`$, independently of length. Consequently every zero-sum family can be reordered with the same bound on unsigned partial sums. A matching lower bound gives the optimal order $`S_2(d)=\Theta(\sqrt d)`$.
